[[File:TestOfElevation-Monster.png|thumb|right|250px|Savage and Feral face off with Ventress in the Test of Elevation.]]
The '''Test of Elevation''' was the third and final challenge in a series of trials that the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] and [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] were forced to pass to go on to become full warriors. Candidates fought amidst the moving stone pillars of the [[Crucible (arena)|Crucible]] in a display of their abilities. Only [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] passed the Test of Elevation during [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress's]] [[Selection/Legends|Selection]].
